import re
urls=['https://s21.q4cdn.com/399680738/files/doc_financials/2021/q3/FB-Q3-2021-Earnings-Call-Transcript.pdf',
'https://www.rev.com/transcripts/meta-facebook-connect-2021-metaverse-event-transcript',
'https://about.fb.com/news/2021/10/founders-letter/',
'https://stratechery.com/2021/an-interview-with-mark-zuckerberg-about-the-metaverse/']
pages={}
for u in urls:
    r=await web_fetch({"url":u})
    if isinstance(r,dict): print(u,r); continue
    c=r[0]['content']; pages[u]=c; print(u,len(c))
pat=re.compile(r"(\bAI\b|artificial intelligence|intelligen)",re.I)
tpat=re.compile(r"(year|decade|20\d\d|next|within|by the end)",re.I)
for u,c in pages.items():
    print("#####",u)
    sents=re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+',c)
    for i,s in enumerate(sents):
        if pat.search(s) and tpat.search(s): print('-',s[:400])

import base64, io
d=json.loads(r) if isinstance(r,str) else r
data=d[0]['content']['source']['data'] if isinstance(d,list) else d['content']['source']['data']
from pypdf import PdfReader
txt="\n".join(p.extract_text() for p in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(data))).pages)
pages[urls[0]]=txt
for u,c in pages.items(): print(u, type(c), len(c) if isinstance(c,str) else '')

reply_text:
I found no dated AI prediction from Mark Zuckerberg in 2021. All three fixed searches ran, and the pages I read show him talking about AI only in the present tense. That year he was mostly making the case for the metaverse.

- **What I read in full:** the official Q3 2021 earnings-call transcript (25 October) and the Stratechery interview (28 October). In both, AI comes up only as present-tense content moderation and as a spending line in the 2022 budget. A spending line is a business forecast, so it doesn't count.
- **Connect 2021 keynote:** the Rev transcript page I opened ends a few minutes into the event, so I couldn't check the rest of the keynote.
- **Two pages I didn't read:**
  - The Founder's Letter and an earlier copy of the Connect transcript were fetched, but my code threw the results away. I read neither, so nothing from them is quoted.
  - The Verge interview from July 2021 wouldn't open. That interview and the full Connect keynote are the obvious next places to check.
- **Founder's Letter forecast, from a search preview only:** it says the metaverse will reach a billion people "within the next decade". That is about the metaverse, not AI, so it would be left out even if confirmed.
- **Searches and page openings:** I used 9 of the 12 searches. A tool bug may have counted some page openings, so I stopped opening pages. That leaves the year not fully covered, which is why `quiet_year` is false even though nothing was found.
